PrototypeProject.title: PrototypeProject
PrototypeProject.description: A user-owned HTML, CSS, and JavaScript web prototype transcribed from an image or interactive mockup.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the prototype owner.

title.description: Human-readable title of the prototype (1-100 characters).

sourceLabel.description: Label describing the source image or mockup.

jsCode.description: Generated or edited interactive JavaScript code.

aiNotes.description: Summary of AI front-end optimization and interactive JS recommendations.

interactiveFeatures.description: Up to 15 short labels describing interactive JS features implemented.

favorite.description: Whether the user marked this prototype as a favorite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

/users/{userId}/prototypes/{prototypeId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing saved HTML/CSS/JS prototypes.
